about_the_game:
🎮 Reporter Desk: Demo Edition

🗞️ Experience the Thrill of Breaking News — Before the Full Story Hits!

Step into the fast-paced world of journalism and get a taste of Reporter Desk before the full release!
In this exclusive demo, you’ll experience the daily chaos of a journalist’s life — answering urgent phone calls, chasing leads, and writing your first breaking stories from your small newsroom.

Your job? Capture the truth behind the city’s mysteries. Every call brings a new opportunity—or danger. Whether it’s a crime scene to photograph or a lead on political corruption, it’s up to you to decide what makes tomorrow’s headlines.

🧭 What’s Included in the Demo

  • 📰 Hands-on Reporting Gameplay: Take your first steps as a rookie journalist, investigating your first major stories.

  • 📞 Fully Playable Day Cycle: Answer calls, chase breaking news, and decide which leads to follow.

  • 🏙️ Explore the Early City Hub: Visit cafés, alleys, and locations filled with early-life events and characters.

  • 🖋️ Preview of the Writing System: Submit your first articles.

🚀 What to Expect in the Full Game

The demo is just the beginning. The full version of Reporter Desk will expand the newsroom experience with:

  • Office upgrades, staff management, and newspaper expansion.

  • Journalism in Action at city.

  • Fully typewriter system. Wrong words will not accept.

  • Basketball challange with city peoples.

💬 Developer’s Note

We created this demo to give players a hands-on feel for Reporter Desk’s unique mix of investigative gameplay and newsroom management.
Your feedback will directly help shape the full release — so don’t forget to share your thoughts on Steam discussions!

🧠 Demo Info (for Steam Compliance)

  • Playable Content: 1 in-game day introducing core gameplay mechanics.

  • Approx. Playtime: 30–60 minutes.

  • Progress Transfer: Save data will not fully carry over to the full release.

  • Available Languages: English (UI + subtitles).

  • Platform: Windows.

short_description: Become a journalist in a dynamic newsroom where every call is a new lead. Investigate news, capture breaking stories with your camera, and expand your newspaper business in a living, breathing city. Will you chase sensational headlines or uphold journalistic integrity?
